editions.text: October 24 added up to 25 species, 252 feeder visits and 403 detections, above the past week's average of 20.7 species, 216.3 visits and 395.3 detections. Tufted Titmice led the visual counts with 93 visits, and Carolina Chickadees, Carolina Wren and House Finch also came in strong. Of the 25 species, 19 were heard and 16 seen, with 10 both. Thirteen species were recorded on all seven days of the past week, including this one, among them Northern Cardinal, Eastern Towhee and Blue Jays, while Brown-headed Cowbird returned after 9 days away and Chipping Sparrow after 26. The audio source was switched between the pi, pi-mic (movo-dom1) and c120 units during the past week, most heavily on October 18. No new species were first heard today.
